records.body:
Hi Ines,

A reminder that your Wrenfield workspace is ready whenever you are -- creating one real project is the easiest way to see what it's for.

records.subject: Welcome aboard, Vantage Collective
records.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for setting up Vantage Collective on Wrenfield. If your team is more than one person, inviting them now tends to pay off -- Wrenfield is built around teammates working on shared tasks, not solo lists.

Let me know how the first week goes.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Six days in with zero activity: no project, no invites, no tickets, and no reply to three Wrenfield emails (email:0e233964, email:07a15e09, email:ee354f18). Fully silent accounts rarely self-start within 8 days, though the active Pro subscription leaves some chance.

draft.subject: A hand with your first project in Wrenfield
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

I know a new tool is easy to put off in a busy week, so no pressure here. One thing worth knowing: in Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting one real project in place is usually what makes the rest click. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and teammates can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a short call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you live and answer anything as we go.

Best,
Priya
